b1-istvankiraly-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Géza Turned West
b1-istvankiraly-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you why Prince Géza turned towards Christianity.
b1-istvankiraly-01.prompt: Tell the official why the baptized Prince Géza sought an alliance with the Christian West.
cues: Say that Géza had been baptized
Say what he sought in the West and why
b1-istvankiraly-01.target: A megkeresztelt Géza fejedelem szövetséget keresett a keresztény Nyugattal, mert meg akarta menteni az országot.
b1-istvankiraly-01.english: The baptized Prince Géza sought an alliance with the Christian West because he wanted to save the country.
b1-istvankiraly-01.canDo: I can explain why Prince Géza sought closer ties with the Christian world in the late 10th century.

b1-istvankiraly-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Crowned King
b1-istvankiraly-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how István became king.
b1-istvankiraly-02.prompt: Tell the official that István defeated his relative Koppány and became a crowned king around the year 1000.
cues: Say what he became and when
b1-istvankiraly-02.target: István legyőzte Koppányt, majd 1000 körül megkoronázott király lett.
b1-istvankiraly-02.english: István defeated Koppány, and then around 1000 became a crowned king.
b1-istvankiraly-02.canDo: I can explain that after Géza's death, István had to defend his succession against his relative Koppány.

b1-istvankiraly-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Church Organised
b1-istvankiraly-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how István organised the Church.
b1-istvankiraly-03.prompt: Tell the official that István organised ten dioceses and founded monasteries, and that every ten villages had to build a church.
cues: Say how many dioceses he organised
Say what the law ordered for the villages
b1-istvankiraly-03.target: István tíz egyházmegyét szervezett, és kolostorokat alapított. Törvényben rendelte el, hogy minden tíz falu építsen egy templomot.
b1-istvankiraly-03.english: István organised ten dioceses and founded monasteries. By law he ordered that every ten villages build a church.
b1-istvankiraly-03.canDo: I can describe how István organized the Hungarian church into ten dioceses with the archbishopric of Esztergom at the centre.

b1-istvankiraly-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Admonitions
b1-istvankiraly-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what the Intelmek were.
b1-istvankiraly-04.prompt: Tell the official that, according to tradition, István wrote the Admonitions for his son.
cues: Say what tradition says about the author
Say who the Admonitions were meant for
b1-istvankiraly-04.target: A hagyomány szerint István király az Intelmeket a fiának, Imre hercegnek írta.
b1-istvankiraly-04.english: According to tradition, King István wrote the Admonitions for his son, Prince Imre.
b1-istvankiraly-04.canDo: I can explain what the Intelmek (Admonitions) were, and to whom István addressed them.

b1-istvankiraly-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Regalia
b1-istvankiraly-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what belongs to the Hungarian coronation regalia.
b1-istvankiraly-05.prompt: Name the regalia that belong to the Holy Crown.
b1-istvankiraly-05.target: A Szent Koronához a jogar, az országalma és a koronázási palást tartozik.
b1-istvankiraly-05.english: The sceptre, the orb and the coronation mantle belong to the Holy Crown.
b1-istvankiraly-05.canDo: I can name the parts of the Hungarian coronation regalia: the crown, the scepter, the orb and the mantle.

b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Was Szent István?
b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you who Szent István was.
b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official who Szent István was and when he was canonized.
cues: Say what happened to him later, and when
b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.target: Szent István Magyarország első megkoronázott királya volt, akit 1083-ban szentté avattak.
b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.english: Saint Stephen was the first crowned king of Hungary, who was canonized in 1083.
b1-istvankiraly-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate Szent István's story: Géza's turn to Christianity, István's coronation, the Christian kingdom he built, his legacy and sainthood, and the Holy Crown.
